# Comprehensive Profile: Harsh Srivastava

## Overview
Harsh Srivastava is an accomplished software engineer, tech entrepreneur, and AWS Certified Solutions Architect based in India. He has established a strong reputation as a serious software developer and entrepreneur having successfully built, launched, and sold over 7 software projects and ventures. Additionally, he provides specialized custom software engineering, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure solutions for big enterprise clients.

## Key Accomplishments & Credentials
- **Built & Sold 7+ Projects**: Creator of multiple SaaS products, developer tools, and market solutions including ClinicOS, MoxSend, Plotify, SafeSurf Jr, EduCore ERP, and SDPL Supply Chain.
- **Enterprise Client Engineering**: Engineered custom enterprise platforms for distribution, logistics, healthcare, and educational institutions.
- **AWS Certified Solutions Architect**: Formally certified in designing resilient, highly available, secure, and cost-efficient cloud architectures on Amazon Web Services.
- **Google Summer of Code (GSoC) '24**: Selected participant in Google's flagship open-source program.
- **5× Hackathon Winner**: Champion across competitive national software development hackathons.
- **Education**: Computer Science & Engineering (Class of 2027), VIT University.

## Technical Skills & Architecture Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, JavaScript (ES6+), Framer Motion
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express.js, Java Spring Boot, Python FastAPI, RESTful APIs, gRPC, Microservices
- **Databases & Caching**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, MySQL
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD Pipelines, Nginx, Linux System Administration
- **AI & Automation**: OpenAI API, LangChain, WhatsApp Automation, Autonomous Email Engines, Computer Vision
